paragraphs.source_en:
Have
you not heard his silent steps? He comes, comes, ever comes.

units.source_en:
Have
you not heard his silent steps?

paragraphs.source_en: Every moment and every age, every day and every night he comes, comes, ever comes.

units.source_en: Every moment and every age, every day and every night he comes, comes, ever comes.

paragraphs.source_en: Many a song have I sung in many a mood of mind, but all their notes have always proclaimed, "He comes, comes, ever comes."

units.source_en: Many a song have I sung in many a mood of mind, but all their notes have always proclaimed, "He comes, comes, ever comes."

ja.t: ってきたが、そのすべての

paragraphs.source_en: In the fragrant days of sunny April through the forest path he comes, comes, ever comes.

units.source_en: In the fragrant days of sunny April through the forest path he comes, comes, ever comes.

paragraphs.source_en: In the rainy gloom of July nights on the thundering chariot of clouds he comes, comes, ever comes.

units.source_en: In the rainy gloom of July nights on the thundering chariot of clouds he comes, comes, ever comes.

paragraphs.source_en: In sorrow after sorrow it is his steps that press upon my heart, and it is the golden touch of his feet that makes my joy to shine.

units.source_en: In sorrow after sorrow it is his steps that press upon my heart, and it is the golden touch of his feet that makes my joy to shine.
